description: This file defines the 'MissileLauncherActivity' class which manages the user interface and hardware interactions for a missile launcher Android app, including USB communication, accelerometer handling, and command execution.

classes.name: MissileLauncherActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling USB device communication, accelerometer sensor events, and user interaction for the missile launcher application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and acquires system services and sensors.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listener when activity pauses.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener and handles USB device connection events.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup; currently no specific logic.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Configures the USB device, verifies interface and endpoint, and starts a background thread for communication.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends control commands to the USB device.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks, specifically firing the missile.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Background loop that polls USB device status and logs updates.
